definitions: The main woody stem of a tree, distinct from its branches and roots.
The elongated, prehensile nose of an elephant.
A large, strong box or case for storing or transporting clothes and other articles.
The main part of the human body apart from the head, neck, and limbs.
examples: An elephant's trunk is very versatile.
She packed her trunk for the journey.
Put the groceries in the trunk.
The injury was to his trunk.
